Dealing Range

A high-to-low range chosen from a meaningful structural event, such as BOS or MSS; basis for premium/discount analysis.

Open interactive ICT Academy →Official ICT channel ↗Official playlists ↗

How to identify and use this concept

  1. Select structural event.
  2. Mark associated swing low/high.
  3. Record timeframe and anchoring rule.
  4. Use consistently until a new qualifying event.
Put price location into consistent HTF framework.

Common mistakes and limitations

Do not choose convenient endpoints after the fact.
